modules.title: Introduction to Agụmagụ Ọnụ (Oral Literature)
modules.html:
Akụkọ ifo (folktales), abụ (songs) and other Igbo oral forms. This section covers introduction to agụmagụ ọnụ (oral literature).

Key points

  • Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ ọnụ' (Oral literature) — Ilu na Akụkọ ifo.
  • Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' — Agụmagụ edere ede.
  • Olee akwụkwọ e ji amata ụdị agụmagụ 'Novel' — Ha niile.
  • Kedu ihe bụ 'Nnyocha agụmagụ' — Literature criticism.

Worked examples

Q: Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ ọnụ' (Oral literature)?
A: Ilu na Akụkọ ifo — Oral literature is transmitted by word of mouth, including proverbs and folktales.

Q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa'?
A: Agụmagụ edere ede — 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' refers to creative written literature.

examples.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa'?

quiz.q: Kedu nke bụ 'Agụmagụ ọnụ' (Oral literature)?
quiz.solution: Oral literature is transmitted by word of mouth, including proverbs and folktales.

quiz.q: Gịnị ka a na-akpọ 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa'?
quiz.solution: 'Agụmagụ a kpara akpa' refers to creative written literature.

quiz.q: Olee akwụkwọ e ji amata ụdị agụmagụ 'Novel'?
quiz.solution: All listed are examples of Igbo novels.

quiz.q: Kedu ihe bụ 'Nnyocha agụmagụ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Literature criticism.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ uru 'Ego nwaanyị' (Bride price) baara n'ala Igbo?
options: Ọ bụ ego e ji azụ nwaanyị
Ọ bụ ihe e ji egosi na nwaanyị ahụ adịghị mma
Ọ bụ ihe nkịtị na-enweghị uru
Ọ na-egosi nkwekọrịta na njikọ dị n'etiti ezinụlọ abụọ
quiz.solution: Bride price is a symbolic token that legalizes the marriage and binds the two families together.

quiz.q: Ịmụ nwa n'ala Igbo na-eweta ọṅụ. Gịnị ka a na-akpọ nleta a na-aleta onye mụrụ nwa ọhụrụ?
quiz.solution: 'Ọmụgwọ' is the traditional postpartum care where a relative (usually the mother or mother-in-law) stays with the new mother.

quiz.q: N'ala Igbo, 'Iru mgbede' bụ ememme a na-emere _____.
quiz.solution: 'Iru mgbede' or 'Fatting room' was a rite of passage for young women preparing for marriage/womanhood.

quiz.q: Ọrụ dinta bụ _____.
options: Ịgba nta ma ọ bụ igbu anụ ọhịa
quiz.solution: A hunter (dinta) is responsible for hunting animals in the forest.

quiz.q: Kedu onye n'ezinụlọ na-elekọta ezinụlọ na inye iwu?
quiz.solution: The father (nna) is traditionally the head and authority figure of the Igbo household.

quiz.q: N'asụsụ Igbo, 'High tone' anaghị enwe akara ọ bụla n'elu vowel. Eziokwu ka ọ bụ asị?
quiz.solution: In Standard Igbo orthography, the high tone (Udaelu) is typically left unmarked.

quiz.q: Olee onye dere akwụkwọ 'Isi Akwu Dara n'Ala'?
quiz.solution: Tony Ubesie is the author of this classic novel set during the Biafran war.

quiz.q: Olee nke kacha mkpa n'ịlụ nwaanyị n'ala Igbo?
quiz.solution: The inquiry/knocking ('Ịjụ ajụjụ') is the essential first step in Igbo marriage.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ikwa ozu'?
quiz.solution: 'Ikwa ozu' refers to funeral rites performed to honor the deceased.

quiz.q: Eze n'ala Igbo:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Igwe/Eze.

quiz.q: Nri ndị Igbo:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Akpụ/Fufu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'One'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Otu.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Fish'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Azụ.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Go'?

quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Personal God.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Ụlọ'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: House.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Oche'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Chair.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Karin Magana' a Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Proverb.

quiz.q: Menene 'Siffa' a Nahawun Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Adjective.

quiz.q: Wanne ne jam'in 'Mota'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Motoci.

quiz.q: Menene 'Kudin Goro'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Token gift/bribe.

quiz.q: Menene 'Shekara'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Year.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ '100' n'asụsụ Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Otu nari.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Morning' n'Igbo?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ututu.

quiz.q: N'asụsụ Igbo, ụdaume ole bụ 'udaume mfe' (light vowels)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Anọ.

quiz.q: Onye nwụọ n'ala Igbo, a na-akpọ 'ị gaa ___'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: be mmuo.

quiz.q: Gịnị bụ 'Two'?
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Abụọ.
